title: Finite type preserved by epimorphic images
statement: For any sheaf of rings R and epimorphism e : A ⟶ B of sheaves of R-modules, if A is of finite type then B is of finite type.

proof.text: Let x be a point and choose an open neighbourhood V on which finitely many sections of A generate A. For any open W contained in V and any section t of B over W, the epimorphism e locally lifts t to sections of A. On a refinement of that covering, each lift is a linear combination of the chosen generators of A, so the corresponding images in B generate t. Thus the images of the finite generating family generate B on V, and since x was arbitrary B is of finite type. Applying the same argument to the open restriction sites gives the relation-kernel application.
